shiftLock.slot: Electronic dual-clutch GR6 transaxle with electronic park lock. Shift to N requires 12V power. Must jump under-hood battery first. Shift to N via paddle shift sequence per owner manual after 12V restored.

steps: STEP 1 — ACCESS BATTERY UNDER HOOD: Open hood. Locate plastic cowl finisher behind windshield wipers on PASSENGER side of engine bay. Pull up 5 white plastic retainer tabs along weather stripping. Slide cowl panel back and up — no need to remove wipers. Battery is under this panel.
STEP 2 — JUMP BATTERY: AGM battery — use AGM-compatible jump pack. Connect directly to battery terminals. Let system power up fully — all dash lights should illuminate.
STEP 3 — SHIFT TO N: Press brake pedal. Use paddle shifters or electronic selector to shift to N as indicated in owner manual. Verify N on instrument cluster.
FLATBED ONLY: AWD is permanent ATTESA E-TS — cannot be disabled or put in 2WD. Never tow with any wheels on ground.
HIGH-VALUE VEHICLE: Use padded flatbed straps ONLY. Never contact front splitter, rear diffuser, carbon body panels, or side skirts with metal hooks or chains.
NOTE: GT-R discontinued in US after 2024 model year. Final US sale 2024.

battery.location: UNDER THE HOOD — behind the windshield wiper cowl panel on the PASSENGER side of the engine bay. Access: open hood, pull up 5 white plastic retainer tabs on weather stripping, remove plastic cowl finisher panel (no need to remove wipers), battery is visible. AGM-type battery. There are NO remote jump terminals — must access battery directly under hood. NOTE: This is NOT in the trunk despite being a transaxle layout — battery is engine bay.

alerts.notes: GT-R R35 (2009-2024). AWD — FLATBED ONLY. Battery in TRUNK under panel — NOT under hood. AGM battery — use AGM jump pack. Electronic DCT requires power. High-value — padded equipment only. Final US sale 2024.

shiftLock.slot: CRITICAL — LEAF HAS NO MECHANICAL SHIFT LOCK OVERRIDE. There is no hidden override cap. The park lock is an ELECTRIC ACTUATOR MOTOR on the reduction gear. To shift to N: MUST restore 12V power first. Jump 12V under hood. Once 12V active: push START button (without brake), then with brake, shift to N via electronic selector.

steps: STEP 1 — JUMP 12V: Connect jump pack to 12V auxiliary battery under hood. Use jump pack only (not another vehicle). Wait for system to fully wake — dashboard lights should appear.
STEP 2 — SHIFT TO N: Foot on brake. Push START button (or key to ON). Electronic selector (joystick/rocker) to N. You should hear park actuator disengage.

IF ELECTRONIC SHIFT FAILS: Last resort — physically unbolt the park actuator motor from top of reduction gearbox and manually rotate the park lock shaft. This is a dealer/shop procedure. Requires removing underbody or interior panels.
DO NOT move Leaf faster than WALKING SPEED without 12V power active — spinning traction motor generates high voltage that can destroy the inverter.
FLATBED ONLY: Electric drivetrain. No wheels-on-ground towing allowed.
NEVER touch orange/yellow HV cables or HV battery enclosure.
Battery (12V): under hood. Battery (HV): under floor — never touch.

battery.location: 12V AUXILIARY BATTERY: under the hood. HV TRACTION BATTERY: 24-40 kWh lithium pack under vehicle floor — NEVER touch orange/yellow HV cables, connectors, or battery casing.
